author: agent
objective: For the Lombardy and Veneto regional daily COVID-19 panel during 21 February–19 May 2020, what are the associations of contemporaneous regional ambient NO2 and PM2.5 (short-term exposure) and regional mean pollution over January 2013–19 May 2020 (long-term exposure) with daily reported COVID-19 cases and deaths, adjusted for lockdown using log-link AR(1) GEE?

scientific_invariants.research_question: For the Lombardy and Veneto regional daily COVID-19 panel during 21 February–19 May 2020, what are the associations of contemporaneous regional ambient NO2 and PM2.5 (short-term exposure) and regional mean pollution over January 2013–19 May 2020 (long-term exposure) with daily reported COVID-19 cases and deaths, adjusted for lockdown using log-link AR(1) GEE?
scientific_invariants.target_outcome_and_population: Daily reported COVID-19 cases and deaths among residents of Lombardia and Veneto, Italy; fatality ratio is an article-reported secondary outcome but counts are the principal target in the contract.
scientific_invariants.principal_contrast: Rate ratio per 1 µg/m³ increase in pollutant, separately for STAP (same-day regional mean) and LTAP (regional mean over 2013-01-01 to 2020-05-19), for daily cases and deaths.
principal_variants: single-pollutant STAP + LTAP + lockdown log-link GEE with AR(1), cases
single-pollutant STAP + LTAP + lockdown log-link GEE with AR(1), deaths
meteorology-adjusted sensitivity (temperature and relative humidity) reported in Tables S2-S4
scientific_invariants.broad_geography: Lombardia and Veneto, Italy (two administrative regions)

article_evidence.finding: Methods §§2.1–2.3 describe EEA monitoring data from January 2013 to May 2020, daily regional STAP, long-term regional LTAP, daily cases/deaths February 21–May 19, lockdown, and log-link GEE AR(1).
Results Tables 1–4 report pollutant models and define the one µg/m³ exposure contrast.
Tables S1–S4 document meteorology-adjusted sensitivity analyses.

execution_design.assignment_method: For each named regional polygon, unweighted mean of daily means across OpenAQ-discovered monitors within the boundary; deterministic spatial-spread maximum 50 stations.
execution_design.source_strategy: OpenAQ archive S3 and v3 for a public-monitor-network recovery route; article-named EEA endpoint was probed but its historical export URL returned HTTP 404.
execution_design.exposure_metric: NO2 STAP: regional same-day unweighted monitor mean in µg/m³.
execution_design.daily_aggregation: AERIS daily aggregation from recovered monitor observations, then unweighted regional monitor mean.
execution_design.analysis_aggregation: Two-region daily panel joined by region name and calendar date to Civil Protection reported daily outcomes.
execution_design.coverage_policy: Report-only; retain the deterministic complete overlap of AERIS recovered NO2 dates for both regions (2020-05-05 through 2020-05-20 boundary outcome overlap expected; exact overlap determined after join). No unsupported completeness threshold.
execution_design.intended_use: Bounded reduced-coverage reanalysis of short-term NO2 association; not a personal exposure or population-weighted regional concentration.

evidence.finding: Both target regional polygons yielded monitor-based NO2 observations; each has 22.47% of the 89-day target window under the first archive retrieval.
PM2.5 OpenAQ route yielded no observations for both target regions and cannot support a PM2.5 fit.
Article-named legacy EEA export URL returned HTTP 404 during direct retrieval probe.

amendments.scientific_justification: The article's regional spatial support and same-day ambient concentration construct are preserved for NO2. OpenAQ is a source substitution and the recovered common time support is reduced; PM2.5 and the article's 8-year LTAP are not imputed or replaced.
